Runs Qwen3.8‑27B on self‑hosted llama.cpp at l"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"ow context, shrinking history so the live prompt stays small, fast, and private—delivering a big‑win"},{"id":"p1s3","text":"dow experience without API cost or data egress. 面向本地的激进上下文压缩插件。自托管 llama.cpp 低上下"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-force-compact"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"**Aggressive, local-first context compaction for DeepSeek Harness agents.**"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"A DSH **Cordis function plugin** that keeps the agent's working context lean by design: serve
`Qwen3"},{"id":"p4s2","text":".8‑27B` on a self-hosted llama.cpp with a modest context, and the plugin shrinks the
conversation it"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"self — a large-window feel with no API cost and no data egress."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"中文"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Why"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"- **Self-hosted inference** — the agent talks to a local OpenAI-compatible llama.cpp server
through "},{"id":"p7s2","text":"the standard DeepSeek adapter; no separate adapter needed.
- **Low context, high signal** — instead "},{"id":"p7s3","text":"of fighting a small cap, the plugin shrinks the
conversation, so the agent reasons over a tight prom"},{"id":"p7s4","text":"pt while keeping deep memory in the
compressed head.
- **Think off for compactions, passthrough ever"},{"id":"p7s5","text":"ywhere else** — `disableThinking: true`
(default) turns thinking off on *this plugin's own compactio"},{"id":"p7s6","text":"n summarization call only*;
every other model request rides the machine's configuration unchanged.
-"},{"id":"p7s7","text":" **Private & free** — no per-token billing, no egress."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## What it does"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"Two compaction engines coexist behind one facade (`resolveCompaction`), transparent to callers:"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"| Engine | Used when | Notes |"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"| **Official** | the `compaction` service resolves in the agent realm | Preferred; delegates to `com"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"paction/basic`. |
| **Builtin** | automatic fallback (typical standard preset isolates the service) "},{"id":"p11s3","text":"| Self-contained persistent transaction on `ctx.sessions` / `ctx.llm.stream` / `ctx.tokenMeter`; reu"},{"id":"p11s4","text":"ses the official `compaction/*` event vocabulary, so it replays safely across builds. |"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"No toggling — official wins when reachable, builtin takes over otherwise."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"### Trigger points"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"- **Per-request guard (`agent/pre-step`)** — reads the session's *projected* context tokens
(the exa"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"ct number the harness renders bottom-right). At `autoThresholdTokens` it rejects the
outgoing reques"},{"id":"p14s3","text":"t and compacts the head instead, retaining the latest `retainLatestTokens`
verbatim. Below the thres"},{"id":"p14s4","text":"hold the request proceeds.
- **Turn end / idle (`agent/status` → `idle`)** — when the agent quiesces"},{"id":"p14s5","text":", optionally
compacts via `compactNow` (gate: `turnEndForceCompactionEnabled`).
- **Manual `/force-c"},{"id":"p14s6","text":"ompact`** — immediate `compactNow` when idle; when busy it queues a
process-local flag consumed at t"},{"id":"p14s7","text":"he next model step. **Loaded lazily** — see "Command
availability" under Install. In the `/` picker "},{"id":"p14s8","text":"the row carries the same face as the
first-party commands: an icon, a localized name and a localized"},{"id":"p14s9","text":" description (the official
presentation table only covers first-party commands, so the client half a"},{"id":"p14s10","text":"ttaches the face
itself — see `AGENTS.md`, "指令行的官方外观").
- **`session/flush`** — the awaited durabili"},{"id":"p14s11","text":"ce
itself — see `AGENTS.md`, "指令行的官方外观").
- **`session/flush`** — the awaited durability checkpoint."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"Every path funnels into the single *"compaction result landed in the session"* boundary — the
same p"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"oint where the LiveUI signal fires."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"Decision key is `projectedTokens` (provider-anchored, same figure as the UI corner), so the
plugin n"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"ever drifts from what you see; the threshold-aware shrink gate skips summarizer calls
that provably "},{"id":"p16s3","text":"cannot pull the session below the threshold (kills the low-threshold dead loop)."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"The builtin transaction bills `shadowedTokenCount` from the **same** `tokenMeter.measure`
per-node p"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"rices the official engine uses, so the meter's collapse protocol settles the drop
correctly — the bo"},{"id":"p17s3","text":"ttom-right counter goes *down* after compaction."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"### Thinking control: scoped to compactions"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"Since the 2026-08 semantics revision, `disableThinking` controls **one thing**: whether this
plugin'"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"s own summarization call (`engine/builtin.js` → `engine/summarizer.js` →
`ctx.llm.stream`) carries `"},{"id":"p19s3","text":"reasoningEffort:'off'`. Everything else is untouched:"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"| Call site | With `disableThinking: true` |"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"| Builtin-engine summarization call | Carries `reasoningEffort:'off'` |
| Every other model request "},{"id":"p21s2","text":"(business, sub-agents, tools, other plugins) | Machine's `LlmCallConfig` unchanged |
| Official `com"},{"id":"p21s3","text":"paction` service calls | Not routed through any plugin seam — unaffected |"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"**A route that cannot express `off` degrades instead of failing.** Not every catalog model
declares "},{"id":"p22s2","text":"an `off` level — pi-ai's `thinkingLevelMap` may map it to `null`, as
`opencode-go/deepseek-v4.1-flas"},{"id":"p22s3","text":"h` does (it accepts only `low` / `high` / `max`, while
`deepseek/deepseek-flash` accepts `off` too)."},{"id":"p22s4","text":" The summarizer probes the route's capability
before the call (`llm.resolveCallConfig`, a detached l"},{"id":"p22s5","text":"ookup with no provider I/O) and, when

process-loc"},{"id":"p26s2","text":"al force flag (`thinkingDisabled` survives only as a legacy predicate).
- `src/hooks/command.js` — t"},{"id":"p26s3","text":"he `/force-compact` command (lazily registered).
- `src/hooks/idle.js` — turn-end forced compaction."},{"id":"p26s4","text":"
- `src/hooks/wire-rewrite.js` — **retired**; keeps only the historical note on why the
`llm/stream`"},{"id":"p26s5","text":" seam cannot carry wire fields. No exports.
- `src/engine/region.js` — head/tail-anchored region sel"},{"id":"p26s6","text":"ection (with the official pairing ledger).
- `src/engine/summarizer.js` — the one-shot LLM summarize"},{"id":"p26s7","text":"r, aligned with official

`purpose:'compaction'` tag, fail-closed finish classification, usage capture); the
summarizatio"},{"id":"p26s9","text":"n **instruction text is localized to Chinese** (structure identical, copy
localized, with both `<com"},{"id":"p26s10","text":"pacted-summary>` tags kept verbatim). The official engine still
uses the English instruction — see t"},{"id":"p26s11","text":"he "摘要指令中文化" section in `AGENTS.md`.
- `src/engine/builtin.js` — the builtin persistent transaction "},{"id":"p26s12","text":"(official `compaction/*` vocab).
- `src/engine/checkpoint.js` — preview + shrink gate + delegation t"},{"id":"p26s13","text":"o the compaction service.
- `src/core/projected.js` — provider-anchored `projectedTokens`.
